items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 June 2026 4:13am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 11 June 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland driving a frontal zone across the British Isles.


##Wind##

South 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the south to start, soon veering southwest 4 or 5, veering west or southwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6 in the evening, backing southwest 3 or 4 overnight into tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Rain or drizzle soon clearing to isolated rain or showers.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain or drizzle, then becoming good occasionally moderate in the afternoon.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, quickly veering west or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
